title: Build the Hotwire and Tailwind application shell
summary: Built accessible public and authenticated Rails shells with responsive native navigation, reusable explicit-local partials, Tailwind component tokens, an honest home/sign-in/dashboard scaffold, server-rendered validation, Turbo frame enhancement, focused error handling, reduced motion and frontend guidance.

tests.notes: 43 runs, 323 assertions, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skips against four PostgreSQL databases
3 runs, 11 assertions, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skips in headless Chrome

mise exec ruby@3.4.10 -- bundle exec rubocop
mise exec ruby@3.4.10 -- bundle exec brakeman --quiet --no-pager --exit-on-warn --exit-on-error
mise exec ruby@3.4.10 -- bundle exec bundler-audit check --update
tests.notes: advisory database updated and no vulnerabilities found
blueprint valid with 120 prompts and 10 ADRs
120 prompts and state were consistent before completion

decisions: Keep the shell server rendered and use native details controls plus one focus-only Stimulus controller; defer charting until a real metrics surface has an accessible fallback
risks: No automated WCAG scanner is installed yet; coverage is targeted semantic keyboard focus responsive and no-JavaScript behavior. Stale ignored public/assets were moved to /tmp so system tests consume the current Tailwind build. Initial system and RuboCop failures were diagnosed and fixed; an incorrect bundle exec importmap invocation was replaced by the repository bin/importmap command.
